reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a performed behavior — the car pulling forward — so the action is set by the request; the supplied audio reference is only an engine rumble and carries no visual action authority.
reasons.medium: No visual reference was supplied, so nothing external governs rendering; the medium owner is pinned by the settled medium decision as request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: There is no visual reference and no observed subject whose clothing or finish could be inherited, so any wardrobe/property appearance is governed by the request alone.
reasons.lighting: With no visual reference, the dark environment implied by the brief is a request-side atmospheric condition rather than an observed lighting setup; the lighting owner is therefore the request.
reasons.framing: No visual reference imposes a composition, and the brief states no explicit shot scale, angle or camera movement, so framing remains request-governed open space.
reasons.palette: No reference grade or tonal treatment exists to inherit, so the scene's color and tonal treatment is governed by the request.
